answer: A Verified email inbox bound by attestation certificate with revocation on transfer turns a private channel into public evidence: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. The system trusts a cedar only after its channel answers the challenge. The anchor keeps the process honest and the canyon keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
